entries.title: Psalms 49:1
segments: ¶<Alamoth. To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.> Give attention to this, all you peoples; let your ears be open, all you who are living in the world.

entries.title: Psalms 49:2
segments: High and low together, the poor, and those who have wealth.

entries.title: Psalms 49:3
segments: From my mouth will come words of wisdom; and in the thoughts of my heart will be knowledge.

entries.title: Psalms 49:4
segments: I will put my teaching into a story; I will make my dark sayings clear with music.

entries.title: Psalms 49:5
segments: What cause have I for fear in the days of evil, when the evil-doing of those who are working for my downfall is round about me?

entries.title: Psalms 49:6
segments: ¶Even of those whose faith is in their wealth, and whose hearts are lifted up because of their stores.

entries.title: Psalms 49:7
segments: Truly, no man may get back his soul for a price, or give to God the payment for himself;

entries.title: Psalms 49:8
segments: (Because it takes a great price to keep his soul from death, and man is not able to give it.)

entries.title: Psalms 49:9
segments: So that he might have eternal life, and never see the underworld.

entries.title: Psalms 49:10
segments: For he sees that wise men come to their end, and foolish persons of low behaviour come to destruction together, letting their wealth go to others.

entries.title: Psalms 49:11
segments: The place of the dead is their house for ever, and their resting-place through all generations; those who come after them give their names to their lands.

entries.title: Psalms 49:12
segments: But man, like the animals, does not go on for ever; he comes to an end like the beasts.

entries.title: Psalms 49:13
segments: This is the way of the foolish; their silver is for those who come after them, and their children get the pleasure of their gold. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 49:14
segments: Death will give them their food like sheep; the underworld is their fate and they will go down into it; their flesh is food for worms; their form is wasted away; the underworld is their resting-place for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 49:15
segments: ¶But God will get back my soul; for he will take me from the power of death. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 49:16
segments: Have no fear when wealth comes to a man, and the glory of his house is increased;

entries.title: Psalms 49:17
segments: For at his death, he will take nothing away; his glory will not go down after him.

entries.title: Psalms 49:18
segments: Though he might have pride in his soul in his life-time, and men will give you praise if you do well for yourself,

entries.title: Psalms 49:19
segments: He will go to the generation of his fathers; he will not see the light again.

entries.title: Psalms 49:20
segments: Man, like the animals, does not go on for ever; he comes to an end like the beasts.
